name: DS Cluster S26: Price Adjustment Methods
description: Tests: futures_continuation with NoAdjustment, BackwardRatio, BackwardPanamaCanal. Verifies return preservation across rolls and PanamaCanal artifact guard.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S26: Price Adjustment Methods
# =============================================================================
# S26 rules:
#   NoAdjustment — raw stitched, gaps at rolls. Current contract only.
#   BackwardRatio — preserves % returns across rolls. DEFAULT CHOICE.
#   BackwardPanamaCanal — preserves $ differences. For spread trading.
#   PanamaCanal + forward returns → -inf at roll artifacts.

src = market_data_source()()

# === NoAdjustment (raw stitched) ===
cont_raw = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# === BackwardRatio (preserves % returns) ===
cont_ratio = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# === BackwardPanamaCanal (preserves $ differences) ===
cont_panama = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# === Returns comparison — Ratio should be smoothest ===
ret_raw = returns(cont_raw.c)
ret_ratio = returns(cont_ratio.c)
ret_panama = returns(cont_panama.c)

# === PanamaCanal artifact guard (S26 rule) ===
fwd_ret_panama = forward_returns(cont_panama.c, 1)
safe_fwd_ret = where(cont_panama.c > 0, fwd_ret_panama)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Adjusted Close: Raw vs Ratio vs Panama',
    category='Adjustment',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NoAdjustment', color=Color.White),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BackwardRatio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BackwardPanama', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cont_raw.c, cont_ratio.c, cont_panama.c))

xy_lines(
    title='Daily Returns by Adjustment Method',
    category='Adjustment',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Raw Returns', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Ratio Returns', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Panama Returns', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(ret_raw, ret_ratio, ret_panama))

xy_lines(
    title='PanamaCanal Forward Return (guarded)',
    category='Adjustment',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Safe Fwd Return', color=Color.Green)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero')])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=safe_fwd_ret)
